bullets.text: Cyclone Murasu has triggered rough seas and heavy rain in Chennai and Thiruvallur, prompting police and IMD warnings.
A sinkhole on Velachery Main Road caused traffic delays following a drinking water pipeline leak.
Heavy rains uprooted trees and inundated roads across Chennai, while disaster response teams were dispatched to Thiruvallur.
A motorcyclist died after a collision with a lorry near Polivakkam in Uthukottai.
Sewage vehicle owners staged a protest by parking vehicles at the Gummidipoondi block development office.
L&T's Vyoma.AI has started construction on a 52 MW AI data centre in Chennai.
Vultr's plan to build 1 GW of AI compute capacity places Chennai at the center of national expansion.
Residents of Venkatapuram Pudukalani thanked the government for resolving a 15-year-old electricity wire issue.
AAVIN invited applications from interested individuals to run new milk parlours in Chennai by November 16.

takeaways: Aavin invites applications from interested individuals to operate new milk parlours across Chennai city.
Applicants must submit their completed forms to the dairy development corporation by November 16.
stories.snippet: சென்னையில் புதிய ஆவின் (AAVIN) பாலகங்களை நடத்துவதற்கு ஆர்வமுள்ளவர்களிடமிருந்து விண்ணப்பங்கள் வரவேற்கப்படுகின்றன.நவம்பர் 16ஆம் தேதிக்குள் சமர்ப்பிக்க ஆவின் நிறுவனம் கேட்டுக்கொண்டுள்ளது. இதற்கான விண்ணப்பப் படிவங்களை ஆவின்…
